title: Your skin can become an “investment”
scenario: A gaming community advertises a token tied to rare skins. The site says connecting your wallet will show the value of your inventory and offers a free token for first-time users.

answers.A: Use a wallet with no funds and no valuable assets if you are only researching how the site works.
answers.B: Connect your normal wallet but reject any transaction that asks to move money.
answers.C: Do not connect a wallet based on a community link; discuss any real-money investment with a parent/guardian and verify the project independently.

explanation: Wallet connections and signatures can authorize more than a visible payment. “Free” tokens are common bait for risky permissions.
proTip: A wallet signature can spend value without looking like a purchase.
